text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Talks aim to find new Gozo fares scheme. New fares for the ferries between Malta and the sister island of Gozo were announced on January 26 and have raised a storm of protest.
- Ombudsman held an inquiry into the section for women at the prisons and found overcrowding and a lack of basic facilities.
L-ORIZZONT - Former government had planned higher Gozo ferry fares.
- New Gozo ferry fares have been planned for 2004.
- New regulations covering hunting of birds to be issued without consultations.
